page.overview:
Who is Dr. Little?

Dr. Little is a major character in He Told Me Everything, the third story in Fazbear Frights 7: The Cliffs. He is a highly energetic science teacher who encourages his students to partake in a strange experiment to be accepted into his Science Club. Dr. Little can be considered the story's main antagonist.

Dr. Little, true to his last name, is a small man with glasses and a mustache. He wears a white lab coat with a collared shirt and a brightly colored necktie printed with the design of a DNA helix. Dr. Little will sometimes wears safety goggles over his glasses, which make his eyes look huge and insectoid.

Dr. Little is very energetic and enthusiastic towards science, usually demonstrating experiments involving fire or carefully controlled explosions. While he claims to not have his students work on anything that would put them in danger, his heavy encouragement to participate and stay committed to the lock-in shows a more sinister side to him. Dr. Little also has a morbid sense of humor, joking about dismemberment and death to his students.

Dr. Little is the teacher of the sophomore science class, as well as the leader of the Science Club. He is revered in the town for the "life changing" experiments he hosts in his class and club. This year, his experiment involves Faz-Goo.
